status: frozen after v18D failed and before constructing a causal-assembly source or loading any new lensing target
purpose: Determine whether a directly measured baryonic assembly-history variable contains halo extent, offset, or orientation information absent from instantaneous density, thermal stress, and projected member stress.

prohibited_replays: one-scale isotropic scalar or tensor memory
another spatial smoothing or diffusion kernel
instantaneous thermal or collisionless stress with a new exponent or amplitude
mechanism_boundary.required_new_information: A measured time-ordering, propagation, or assembly variable that distinguishes equal instantaneous baryonic density/stress snapshots with different histories.

required_products: member positions, spectroscopic redshifts, and uncertainties
X-ray surface-density and resolved-temperature maps with uncertainties
shock, cold-front, or radio-relic geometry with propagation speed or a quantitative upper bound
BCG, intracluster-light, stellar, and gas mass maps on one WCS
declared uncertainty ensemble for transverse velocity and line-of-sight depth

decision_rule: If the time-information gate fails, classify the proposal as another instantaneous-stress law and retire it.
If projection or identifiability fails, report data insufficiency without claiming a physics falsification.
If the source passes but frozen spent-pair transfer fails, retire baryonic causal history as the direct missing-field source.
Only a complete source and transfer pass authorizes derivation of a covariant one-metric action; no holdout opens at this stage.
